verdict.rationale: FreshBooks exposes a full REST API (invoices, expenses, payments, journal entries, reports) with an official SDK, letting AI-native users programmatically extract virtually all their data in JSON, which is a reasonably open format. However there is no documented bulk export-to-open-format (CSV/JSON dump) feature, no data portability/GDPR export tool, and probes show no llms.txt or markdown docs, suggesting export is only via manual API integration rather than a one-click 'leave with your data' path. missing for 10: a native bulk data export/download feature, documented data portability guarantees, and independent evidence of successful full-account export via the API.
